_comment: The instances pr-tests.yml takes at their main, at the commit its pin job reads, in place of folio-assistant's index lock. cat-harness, with bootstrap-tools and bootstrap, because cat-harness main is generated with them (see the workflow header). folio-assistant-core, folio-assistant-sci, fhir-harness and who-iris, because this repository's main moves with theirs: a PR here that dropped the content/pipeline link (#473) needed fhir-harness main (fhir-harness#118), one that declared a plugin slot (#468) needed the core main that fills it (core#160), and gen:jsonld:check (always-green) needs who-iris main after tools#2106 and core#790 added table block JSON-LD regenerated in who-iris#265; under the lock they read as failures until the index re-pinned. Test material, so it may name layers above this one (check:reference-direction's TEST MATERIAL rule); the workflow names none of them.
